title: hieracium tommasinianum
intro: Hieracium tommasinianum, commonly known as the Alpine Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium tommasinianum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
